notablePrerequisites:
Dean of the Root.
Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Slimefoot, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.name: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root
